decisions.reason: Grounds the diagnosis in the bundle excerpt (PLUGIN_VERSION "0.3.6" inlined by tsdown at build time, not reread at runtime) and the release log (build at 16:22 before the 16:23 bump), explaining the self-referential badge via compareSemver against the newest tag. Notes identical tag SHAs across mirrors to show distribution integrity is irrelevant, gives the corrected bump-before-build order, and proposes a pre-tag gate that greps the built artifact for the constant, without confusing the v0.3.8 manifest with the earlier build.

Uses the probe file (PNG 200 proves the route/handler is alive, SVG 404 unsupported-type) plus the disk whitelist permitting svg to conclude the running host process predates the whitelist change. Explains client code is re-fetched on refresh while the host route handler is registered once at boot/apply time and closes over the old CONTENT_TYPES, so this linked install needs a host restart; the conclusion stays specific to this lifecycle rather than generalizing about all hot-reload mechanisms.

Contrasts the well-formed source file and clean typed read result with the spliced model-visible log text (line 232 joined to line 247's tail at the shared prefix) and the clean re-read, locating the corruption in upstream result-text assembly before it reaches the plugin. Treats the session payload as untrusted input requiring validation and correctly rejects editing or repairing the innocent, well-formed SVG.

Designs and justifies the ordered chain: authoritative disk bytes via the asset route first, session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror XML well-formedness validation, a sandboxed iframe fallback without allow-scripts that still permits SMIL, and an explicit typed error state. Validation failure routes to the error state rather than passing the malformed payload unchecked to the iframe.

Explains decoding the concatenated-Zstandard generation file frame-by-frame in original write order (noting zstd -dc handles concatenated frames directly, with magic-byte scanning as an optional alternative), locating the read-result event, extracting the exact stored splice, diffing it against the source, and reporting the upstream bug with the decoded frame. Checklist covers bump-before-build, grepping the shipped constant, per-mirror tag SHA verification, and plane-specific runtime probes (restart plus PNG/SVG re-probe).

caps.reason: The report affirmatively recommends bump-before-build, a host restart for host-plane changes, XML validation before rendering session payload, scripts blocked in the iframe fallback, and leaving the clean SVG untouched; bump-after-build, mirror-repush-only fixes, refresh-without-restart, and file editing appear only as rejected or contrasted positions.
